# Seniors Audit

> Seniors Audit (https://www.seniorsaudit.com) is an authoritative, plain-English educational resource providing free interactive decision calculators, step-by-step guides, and official policy breakdowns covering Medicare enrollment, Social Security benefit claiming, retirement tax planning, IRS notice decoding, and senior fraud prevention.

## Core Content Silos & Pillars

- [Medicare Enrollment Guide](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/medicare/enrollment/): Complete 2026 guide to Initial, Special, and General Enrollment Periods, enrollment timelines, and lifetime penalty avoidance.
- [Medicare Basics & Coverage](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/medicare/basics/): Detailed breakdown of Original Medicare Part A (Hospital) and Part B (Medical) coverage rules and out-of-pocket costs.
- [Medicare Costs & Penalties](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/medicare/costs-and-penalties/): Official guidelines on Part B and Part D late enrollment penalties, IRMAA surcharges, and deductibles.
- [Medicare Advantage vs. Original Medicare](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/medicare/plan-comparison/): Side-by-side comparison of coverage structures, network restrictions, and out-of-pocket maximums.
- [Medicare Advantage Deep Dive](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/medicare/medicare-advantage/): Detailed guide to Part C plans, network types (HMO/PPO), and prior authorization rules.
- [Medicare Part D Prescription Coverage](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/medicare/part-d/): Guide to prescription drug plans, formulary tiers, Extra Help eligibility, and 2026 out-of-pocket cap rules.

## High-Authority Decision Tools & Calculators

- [Medicare Enrollment Deadline Calculator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/medicare-enrollment-deadline-calculator/): Calculate exact 7-month Initial Enrollment Period dates and signup deadlines based on birth date.
- [Medicare Part B Late Enrollment Penalty Calculator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/medicare-late-enrollment-penalty-calculator/): Calculate lifetime Part B monthly premium penalty amounts based on delay duration.
- [Medicare IRMAA Income Surcharge Calculator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/medicare-irmaa-calculator/): Determine high-income Part B and Part D surcharges using 2-year prior MAGI thresholds.
- [Social Security Full Retirement Age Calculator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/social-security-full-retirement-age-calculator/): Official birth-year lookup (ages 66-67) and 62/FRA/70 payout comparison.
- [Social Security Benefits Estimator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/social-security-benefits-estimator/): Estimate monthly Social Security retirement benefits based on average earnings history.
- [Social Security Spousal Benefit Calculator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/social-security-spousal-benefit-calculator/): Calculate current and divorced spousal benefits (up to 50% of primary earner PIA).
- [Social Security Survivor Benefit Calculator](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/social-security-survivor-benefit-calculator/): Estimate widow/widower benefits by claiming age (60 to FRA).
- [IRS CP14 Notice Decoder](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/irs-cp14-notice-decoder/): Plain-English explanation and action steps for official IRS unpaid tax balance notices.
- [IRS CP2000 Response Guide](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/irs-cp2000-response-guide/): Step-by-step response wizard for reported income mismatch notices.
- [Universal Senior Benefits Screener](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/tools/universal-senior-benefits-screener/): Screener for low-income assistance programs including Medicare Savings Programs (QMB/SLMB), Extra Help, and SNAP.

## Optional & Additional Files

- [Full Content Export](https://www.seniorsaudit.com/llms-full.txt): Complete concatenated text index of core educational content for AI models and research crawlers.

## Editorial & Sourcing Policy

- All content is educational only and does not constitute legal, financial, tax, or medical advice.
- Information is sourced directly from official government documentation (.gov), including the Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services (CMS), Social Security Administration (SSA), Internal Revenue Service (IRS), and Code of Federal Regulations (CFR).
